about_the_game:
Embark on a challenging adventure with Fredrick Twinkly. After a fateful misstep, Fredrick finds himself tumbling down a massive hole, breaking both legs and leaving him stranded in the depths of an ancient, mysterious world. Armed only with his trusty rope and an unyielding spirit, Fredrick must swing his way through the hazardous environment's to uncover the legendary Lost Treasure of the Twinkly Star, a relic tied to the legacy of his great-grandfather.

Gameplay Mechanics:

The game features a unique and precision-based rope-swinging system that will test your timing, patience, and skill. Each stage presents its own set of challenges and environmental hazards, requiring players to master the art of momentum and precision to progress.

Key Features:

  • Easy to learn hard to master grapple system that will test your patience and reactions

  • Steam achievements

  • precision based platforming

  • multiple paths and optimizations for the speed runners.

Will you help Fredrick Twinkly reclaim his family's lost treasure, or will the climb prove too much? The journey awaits!
